access_links.label: Open Data Nantes Métropole dataset page

description: Appuis-vélos de Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nantes Métropole. Appuis-vélos sur le territoire de Nantes Métropole Localisation des appuis vélos situés sur l’espace public. La donnée est issue d’un inventaire complet réalisé en 2020 et 2021. L’inventaire a été réalisé sur les espaces ouverts à la circulation publique (dont voies spécifiques cycles). Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are stationnement, vélo, Naolib. The portal shows 4,106 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
